title: More Powerful Game Rules
body:
\*\*This mod adds 49+ new /gamerule options (more in future)  
\*\*

**In 1.16+, you can also set these during the Create New World menu**

Most of these rules are NOT enabled by default, especially the "breaking changes" ones like disabling hunger, make sure you go through them and set up the ones you like

__**Gamerules added for Bedrock Parity**__ 

tntExplodes: Whether TNT explodes after activation

respawnBlocksExplode: Prevents beds/respawn anchors from exploding in other dimension

__**Gamerules that disable features**__

disableFarmlandTrampling: Farmland is as strong as dirt, trampling does not destroy it

disableHunger: Players hunger will never drain, and the hunger bar above your XP bar is not visible anymore

disableBiomeFreezeIce : Disable water freezing due to biome temperature  
disableBlockGravity : Disable blocks falling from gravity (sand, gravel, …)

disableCriticalHits : All critical hits are disabled, they only do normal damage

disableCropGrowth: Crops cannot grow

disableSaplingGrowth: Saplings cannot grow  
disableVillagerTrading : Disable villager trading  
disableDecayLeaves : Disable naturally decaying leaves  
disableDecayCoral : Disable coral decaying grey  
disableGenerateStone : Disable stone generation from liquid  
disableGenerateObsidian : Disable obsidian generation from liquid  
disableLightMeltIce : Disable ice melting from things like light levels  
disableMobItemPickup : Disable item pickup when any Mob joins the world 

disableEndermanTeleport: They can never teleport

disableShulkerTeleport: They can never teleport

disableTargetingPlayers :  Disable mob ai from targeting players, they treat you as invisible  
disableLightningTransform : lightning wont mutate mobs like charted creepers  
disablePortalCreationNether: Players cannot ignite portals  
disablePortalCreationEnd: Players cannot socket eyes into the portal frame

__**Gamerules that add or update features**__  
doSugarGrowthUnlimited : Sugar cane growth unlimited height  
doCactusGrowthUnlimited : Cactus growth unlimited height

doMapsAlwaysUpdate : Update maps from inventory even if not held by player  
doEyesAlwaysBreak : Ender Eyes always break when thrown  
doInstantEating : Food is eaten instantly every time  
doInstantExp : No delay on XP pickup  
doArmorStandWeapons : Allow equipping armor stand main & offhand

doLilypadsBreak : Lily Pads break when player falls on them, preventing damage  
doNetherVoidAbove : Nether deals void damage above 128

doFriendlyIronGolems : Iron golems treat players as villagers

__**Gamerule extensions**__

keepInventoryArmor : Keep armor after death (requires keepInventory=true)  
keepInventoryExperience : Keep experience after death (requires keepInventory=true)

   
mobGriefingCreeper : Destructive creepers (requires mobGriefing=true)  
mobGriefingEnderman : Destructive enderman (requires mobGriefing=true)  
mobGriefingVillager : Destructive villagers (requires mobGriefing=true)  
mobGriefingZombie : Destructive zombies (requires mobGriefing=true)  
mobGriefingWither : Destructive wither (requires mobGriefing=true)  
mobGriefingRavager : Destructive ravagers (requires mobGriefing=true)  
mobGriefingSilverfish : Destructive silverfish (requires mobGriefing=true)  
mobGriefingGhast : Destructive ghast (requires mobGriefing=true)  
mobGriefingBlaze : Destructive blaze (requires mobGriefing=true)

mobGriefingSnowgolem;

__**Damage related gamerules**__

cactusDamage : Cactus Damage  
berryDamage : Berry Damage  
pearlDamage : Ender Pearl Damage  
suffocationDamage : Suffocation Damage
